dogecoin.text: The Sweden-based firm announced the news over Twitter on Wednesday, saying that customers can now pay for Airbnb gift cards in bitcoin (BTC), ether (ETH), litecoin (LTC), dogecoin (DOGE) and dash (DASH).<<<<<<<<<<<<<
. Bitcoin, Litecoin, BTC Cash, Ethereum, XRP, Dash, and Dogecoin are the most popular coins
